protocol_approach: WebView 加载 courseTableForStd.action, 注入 JS 重写 XHR open/send 拦截 POST courseTableForStd!courseTable.action 的 requestBody(含 semester.id=N)与 responseText; 返回为 HTML 内嵌 JS 课表网格(activity = new TaskActivity(...) + index = day*unitCount+session), Swift 正则切片解析出课程 7 字段、星期/节次坐标、二进制周次串后逐周展开成日历事件
exact_regex_or_code_snippet: 拦截条件: this._method === 'POST' && this._url.includes('courseTableForStd!courseTable.action') | 学期: let pattern = "semester\\.id=(\\d+)" | 任务字段: let taskActivityPattern = #"TaskActivity\("([^"]*)",\s*"([^"]*)",\s*"([^"]*)",\s*"([^"]*)",\s*"([^"]*)",\s*"([^"]*)",\s*"([^"]*)"(?:\s*,\s*(?:"[^"]*"|null))*\);"# | 坐标: let indexPattern = #"index\s*=\s*(\d+)\s*\*\s*unitCount\s*\+\s*(\d+);"#  (dayOfWeek=match[1], 0=周一; session=match[2]+1, 0起) | 切片锚点: targetLine="table0.marshalTable" → 截断后以 "(?<=activity = new)(.*?)(?=activity = new)" 分块 | 周次: schedule 二进制串逐字符, index>0 且 char=="1" → weekNumbers.append(index); 无显式单双周逻辑(单双周即该串对应位为1) | 入口 URL: https://jwxt.shmtu.edu.cn/shmtu/courseTableForStd.action · https://applicationnewjw.ecnu.edu.cn/eams/courseTableForStd.action · https://eams.sufe.edu.cn/eams/courseTableForStd!index.action
verdict_reason: 三校独立实现交叉印证 Sleepy kingo_new 预期: 课表数据确在 HTML 内嵌 JS 中, 以 TaskActivity(...) 构造调用携带课程字段、index=day*unitCount+session 网格坐标、二进制周次串, 经 Struts2 action courseTableForStd!courseTable.action POST(semester.id) 获取
